subject: Physical Sciences
curriculum_authority: Cambridge International Education (Cambridge Assessment International Education, part of Cambridge University Press & Assessment) authors its own syllabuses. Unlike the IEB tree - which assesses the DBE's CAPS curriculum and therefore references CAPS content - the Cambridge content authority is the per-subject Cambridge SYLLABUS DOCUMENT itself. No content in this tree may be derived from, or defaulted to, the CAPS or IEB trees.
scope: Global. Cambridge qualifications are taught in schools worldwide and are not tied to any one country's national curriculum or school calendar.
equivalence_note: South Africa's 'Physical Sciences' is a single subject combining Physics and Chemistry with no Biology. Cambridge HAS carried exactly that combination - IGCSE Physical Science 0652, whose content is Chemistry sections plus Physics sections and nothing else - but it is being WITHDRAWN, with November 2026 as its final examination series. After that, no single Cambridge qualification matches the South African combination: the multi-science awards (0653 Combined, 0654 Co-ordinated Double) all include Biology, and at AS & A Level there is no combined science option at all. The primary mapping is therefore the Physics + Chemistry PAIR taken as two separate subjects - the only mapping that survives the withdrawal and the only one available at Advanced level.

adjacent_not_mapped.title: Cambridge IGCSE Physical Science
adjacent_not_mapped.why_not_mapped: STRUCTURALLY THE EXACT MATCH for South African Physical Sciences - Chemistry sections plus Physics sections, both compulsory, no Biology - but WITHDRAWN, with November 2026 the final examination series. Cambridge names 0610, 0620, 0625, 0653 and 0654 as the alternatives. Not mapped, because a stream built on it would expire immediately; recorded prominently, because anyone comparing the two curricula will find it and needs to know why it is not the answer.

adjacent_not_mapped.title: Cambridge IGCSE Sciences - Co-ordinated (Double Award)
adjacent_not_mapped.why_not_mapped: Biology, Chemistry AND Physics in one cross-referenced syllabus, awarded as two identical grades. Broader than South African Physical Sciences because of the Biology component; mapping it would misstate scope.

adjacent_not_mapped.title: Cambridge IGCSE Science - Combined
adjacent_not_mapped.why_not_mapped: The same three sciences as 0654 but a single award, one grade, and reduced depth. Same Biology objection.

adjacent_not_mapped.title: Cambridge O Level Physics 5054 / Chemistry 5070
adjacent_not_mapped.why_not_mapped: The O Level route rather than IGCSE. No chemistry-plus-physics-only O Level equivalent of 0652 was found; it may not exist.

consumer_rule: Serving 'physical_sciences' to a Cambridge learner means serving TWO Cambridge subjects. A consumer must resolve which of the pair a topic belongs to, must not present a Combined or Co-ordinated Science scope as if it were the pair, and must not offer 0652 to anyone examined after November 2026.
content_status: pending_syllabus_ingestion: the syllabus documents that carry the actual curriculum content have not been fetched from this environment (Cambridge hosts are blocked by egress policy). Aims, content lists and assessment objectives come from those documents and are deliberately absent rather than guessed.
